requiredAccounts.description: Wallet that signs and sends the deployment transaction; becomes the initial owner via the constructor argument
0x5469a029dbf2138723eD005634F4Baa951b2Bc8f; must be able to call setFeePolicy after deployment

steps: Confirm deployer wallet and initial owner 0x5469a029dbf2138723eD005634F4Baa951b2Bc8f.
Confirm target network Ethereum Sepolia, chain id 11155111.
Deploy TickMovementFeeHook with the constructor arguments above using your own wallet.
Mine or derive a CREATE2 address whose permission bits match beforeSwap=true and afterSwap=true.
Verify getHookPermissions() returns beforeSwap=true and afterSwap=true.
Bind the hook to a dynamic-fee pool through the PoolManager.
